name: @niq.run/hello-worker
description: Reference niq worker — a complete, small example of the worker contract: state, text and object replies, a declared broadcast, worker.readme/worker.help, config layering, graceful shutdown and fake-bus tests. Built on @niq.run/worker-sdk.

scripts.release: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || { echo "Error: git working tree not clean" >&2; exit 1; } && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm version --no-git-tag-version && npm publish
